articles.preview_en: My friend John Varah, who has died aged 67 of heart failure, was one of Britain’s most influential community artists.
articles.preview_ru: My friend John Varah, who has died aged 67 of heart failure, was one of Britain’s most influential community artists.
articles.full_en: My friend John Varah, who has died aged 67 of heart failure, was one of Britain’s most influential community artists. A cultural anarchist dedicated to creating festivals, parades and illuminated spectacles, he was an inventor as much as an artist, surrounded by coils of wire, soldering irons and improbable contraptions as he coaxed ideas into life. Over the years he created and curated a number of popular events, including the annual Burning the Clocks ritual in Brighton, in which, on the winter solstice, thousands of people walk through the city carrying handmade paper-and-willow lanterns containing their hopes and dreams for the year.
